_note: Candidate registry for Indiana 2026. Every record comes from the state's official list of candidates for the November 3, 2026 general election (Indiana Secretary of State, Election Division, 2026 General Election Candidate List (Candidate List, Abbreviated, all counties, 2026 General Election 11/3/2026; file generated September 22, 2026), linked in source_url; a race from another official list links it in roster_source_url). Names and party labels are as the list prints them (mixed case where the list prints capitals). Nothing in a record is invented: no bios, photos, websites or fundraising.
_source: Indiana Secretary of State, Election Division, 2026 General Election Candidate List (Candidate List, Abbreviated, all counties, 2026 General Election 11/3/2026; file generated September 22, 2026) (https://www.in.gov/sos/elections/files/Candidate_List_Abbreviated_20260922_011251PM.xlsx); sitting members matched to congress.gov (bioguide_id).
